title: Open and closed restrictions of coefficient-linear extension by zero
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a commutative condensed ring, with coefficient ring objects $\Lambda_T=p_T^*\Lambda$ and module objects as in [sk-def-sfb-module-objects]. Let $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ be a quasi-compact open immersion of schemes and $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ a closed immersion whose image is $X\setminus j(U)$. Use coefficient module pullbacks $g^*=\operatorname{Ext}_{\alpha_g}\operatorname{mapMod}(g^*_{\Ab})$ [sk-def-sfb-module-pushforward-pullback] and the coefficient-linear extension by zero $j_!$ [sk-def-sfb-module-lower-shriek]. For every $M\in\Mod_{\Lambda_U}$ there are natural isomorphisms $j^*j_!M\cong M$ and $i^*j_!M\cong0$. No finiteness condition on $\Lambda$ or Noetherian condition on the schemes is required.

source.place: Proof: "On $U_a$ the restriction of $j_!M$ is $M|_{U_a}$, because $j^*j_!\cong\mathrm{id}$. On $X\setminus U$ it is $0$"; isolate the coefficient-category restriction identities.

proof.text: The abelian pro-etale open extension is fully faithful. Its linearization is fully faithful because the lifted unit has the same underlying abelian unit and the module forgetful functor reflects isomorphisms. Restriction of scalars along alpha_j is an equivalence, since alpha_j is invertible. Their composite is exactly the specified internal openImmersionLowerShriek, so this functor is fully faithful. Apply unit_isIso_of_L_fully_faithful to its specified adjunction; the inverse of its unit is the natural isomorphism j^*j_! ≅ identity.

The complement equation gives Disjoint(range j,range i). Apply the existing internal disjoint-pullback vanishing theorem to j and i. Each object i^*j_!M is zero, hence has its canonical isomorphism to the chosen zero module.

Package these zero-object isomorphisms with NatIso.ofComponents. For any module morphism, the naturality square commutes because its two composites have zero target, and hence are equal. Together with the inverse unit from Step 1 this proves both Nonempty assertions. The empty-open, whole-open, zero-module and zero-coefficient-ring cases are included in the same argument.

proof_origin.place: The two restriction assertions, proved directly using the existing source module functors: full faithfulness of the linearized open extension, the inverse of its specified unit, and disjoint-image vanishing. No sectionwise module transport is needed.
